thread:
alex: Starting a short runbook thread for air-gapped private cluster bring-up. I sketched the bootstrap + validation checklist below — please poke holes and add any site/network handoff items.

maya: Nice, sharing a baseline. Are we assuming customer provides cross-connect + L3 static routes?

alex: Yes — assume L2/L3 trunk and a static route to the cluster subnets. We'll include BGP notes as an optional step.

priya: Add note: customer must provide ACLs for registry mirror access and for NTP and CRL endpoints (if not fully air-gapped).

kyle: Quick checklist idea: 1) Hardware racked & powered, 2) BMC access verified, 3) Bootloader updated, 4) Base OS installed + kernel tuned, 5) Local registry seeded.

alex: Exactly. I'll paste the minimal bootstrap steps: 

alex: ```
# bootstrap steps (high-level)
- Verify rack and PDUs, BMC access to each host
- Flash SSH key / install base image (CentOS 8-stream derivative)
- Set static IPs, VLANs, default gateway per customer plan
- Configure /etc/hosts with control-plane hostnames for first-boot
- Install containerd and K8s prereqs offline (use mounted package bundle)
- Seed local registry with model images and runtime artifacts
- Configure local apt/yum repo or repo-mirror for OS packages
- Install and configure node-exporter and nv_peer_memory drivers
```

maya: For the registry: make sure signatures are included and we have the cosign public keys pre-provisioned. Customer may want to verify image signatures before allowing deploy.

sam: ops-bot: artifact-sign-check reports: all images in tarball have signatures. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy-bundle-v2 uploaded to target NFS at /mnt/airgap/bundles/2026-03-12 by alex

priya: Validation tests we should run post-bootstrap: GPU health (nvidia-smi --query), NVLINK check, memory burn-in, kernel reprobe test, nvidia-container-runtime test. Keep each test with expected pass criteria.

kyle: Short commands for validation, paste into runbook: 

kyle: ```
# GPU smoke tests
nvidia-smi -L
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,uuid,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv
# run a lightweight CUDA workload container
docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.1-base nvidia-smi
```

alex: Networking validations: 
- Confirm management VLAN can reach control-plane via SSH
- Confirm container registry reachable via configured IP and 443
- Confirm NTP reachable or local NTP server configured
- Confirm MTU across path (IPv4 jumbo frames if configured)

maya: Also verify node-level firewall rules: we expect kubelet ports + etcd ports open only on control plane. Provide customers the small ACL list.

priya: For air-gapped certs: generate CA offline, sign kube-apiserver and kubelet certs, and verify CRL is included in bundle. Add step: record serial numbers.

alex: Handoff checklist to customer network/SRE: 
- IP blocks and example iptables/nft rules to allow control-plane <-> nodes
- Routes to local registry and NFS appliance
- DNS entries for control-plane endpoints and model-serving hostnames
- Cross-connect test: we need them to ping control-plane VIP and fetch a small blob from registry mirror

sam: Who on the customer's side signs off? Need primary contact + backup. Also need confirmation of hours for maintenance window for final cutover.

maya: Add cost note: if they request expanded rack power or burst GPUs beyond reservation we'll need to update billing; include contact to sales/ops for quotes.

kyle: After validation, run minimal canary deploy: sample model image, run 1 replica on GPU node, assert inference latency < 80ms for 1-token warm-up. If fails, fallback to CPU scaled service and collect logs.

priya: Monitoring: ensure Prometheus scraping: node-exporter, nv_gpu exporter, kube-state-metrics; push alert rules for GPU temperature > 85C, OOM/kubelet restarts, and registry sync lag.

alex: Example handoff message to send to customer (short): 

alex: "We completed the on-site bootstrap. Please confirm: (1) BGP/static routes in place for 10.240.0.0/16, (2) ACLs allow 10.240.0.10:5000 (registry), (3) DNS records created for api.private.example.com -> 10.240.0.5. Once confirmed we'll run canary deploy at agreed window."

maya: Add one more — PCI/Compliance note: if they require HSM integration for KMS, record the slot id and test keywrap before handing off.

sam: ops-bot: pre-check completed: packages present, signatures OK, package repo mounted.

ops-bot: runbook-step: preflight-checks OK -> ready-for-validation (executor: alex)

kyle: I'll own the canary deployment and perf validation. Schedule 2h window tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC.

priya: I'll draft the ACL & DNS snippet and the cert serial export to include in Handoff doc.

alex: Great. Final small TODOs: - add optional BGP template, - add rollback steps (repoint VIP to old control plane), - attach package bundle SHA256 sums to the handoff.

maya: LGTM :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — I'll convert this thread into the short runbook doc and attach the formal checklist + signing procedure. Leaving this thread open for any blockers.
